scene: The crane warms your hands, illuminating three strange departures at the roof's edge.
picture: Flat side-view across the rooftop edge. On the far left sits a tethered striped balloon basket. The boy in his orange puffer vest holds the glowing origami crane. In the centre waits a sleek wooden ice sled upon a frost chute. On the right, a yellow chairlift hangs ready beside its pylon.
shown: a striped hot-air balloon basket tethered on the left side
a runnered ice sled waiting at an icy slide in the centre
a dangling metal chairlift swinging beside a pylon on the far right
